name: Medical — UK Biobank (shortcut)
description: UK Biobank–only form with the same pipeline shape. For NHANES, All of Us, MIMIC, SEER, or mixed registry studies, start with template **Database research — UKB, NHANES, All of Us, MIMIC, SEER** (medical-database-research).

literature.label: Primary Clinical Research Question
literature.placeholder: What exact exposure-outcome or cohort question should this UKB study answer?

literature.label: Clinical Question Scope
literature.placeholder: Disease area, exposure, and outcome boundary

literature.label: Knowledge Base Scope
literature.placeholder: Which phenotypes, exposures, covariates, endpoints, and modalities should stay in scope

literature.label: Key References
literature.placeholder: One paper or UKB resource per line

literature.label: Seed Papers / UKB Anchors
literature.placeholder: One seed cohort paper, code list source, or UKB resource per line

literature.label: Prior Evidence Summary
literature.placeholder: What is already known vs unresolved in UKB-related literature

literature.label: Evidence Requirements
literature.placeholder: One must-have evidence item or design constraint per line

literature.label: UKB Assets Needed
literature.placeholder: Primary care, HES, death registry, imaging, genetics, proteomics, etc.

ideation.label: Research Goal
ideation.placeholder: Association, prediction, causal inference, or descriptive epidemiology goal

ideation.label: Clinical / Scientific Gap
ideation.placeholder: Which clinical uncertainty or methodological gap should this cohort analysis close?

ideation.label: Cohort Framing
ideation.placeholder: Target population, index date, follow-up logic, and study design

ideation.label: Phenotype and Endpoint Plan
ideation.placeholder: How case/control definitions, covariates, and endpoints will be operationalized

ideation.label: Population and setting
ideation.placeholder: UKB source population and analytic setting

ideation.label: Inclusion criteria
ideation.placeholder: One operational inclusion rule per line

ideation.label: Exclusion criteria
ideation.placeholder: One operational exclusion rule per line

ideation.label: Study design
ideation.placeholder: Retrospective cohort, target trial emulation, etc.

ideation.label: Estimand
ideation.placeholder: Population, contrast, outcome, horizon, and effect scale

experiment.label: Primary Analysis Goal
experiment.placeholder: Primary endpoint, model objective, or causal contrast

experiment.label: UKB Data Source Plan
experiment.placeholder: Exact data returns, table sources, field IDs, instances, and linkage assets

experiment.label: Cohort Construction Protocol
experiment.placeholder: Inclusion/exclusion, covariates, missingness strategy, and derivation rules

experiment.label: Statistical Evaluation Plan
experiment.placeholder: Model family, validation design, calibration, sensitivity analyses, and subgroup checks

publication.label: Paper Outline
publication.placeholder: How to structure introduction, cohort methods, and key results

publication.label: Figures/Tables Plan
publication.placeholder: Flowchart, baseline table, forest plots, calibration, subgroup analyses

publication.label: Reproducibility Artifact Plan
publication.placeholder: Field manifest, cohort derivation spec, codebook, and analysis notebook outputs

promotion.label: Slide Outline
promotion.placeholder: Clinical problem, cohort, results, and impact story

promotion.label: Homepage Plan
promotion.placeholder: Project page structure and key visuals

promotion.label: Video Assembly Plan
promotion.placeholder: How to combine slides, charts, and narration

quality_gate: The primary clinical research question is precise enough to map to a UKB cohort design
Knowledge-base scope, required UKB assets, and linked datasets are explicitly listed
Prior UKB literature and unresolved gaps are summarized concretely

task_blueprints.title: Map prior UKB literature and required UKB assets
task_blueprints.description: Summarize relevant UKB studies, list necessary field groups and linked resources, and note known design caveats.

task_blueprints.title: Position the clinical question against known UKB evidence
task_blueprints.description: Clarify what is already established, what remains uncertain, and why this cohort analysis is worth running.

quality_gate: A concrete clinical or scientific gap is stated clearly
Study design, cohort window, and endpoints are operationally defined
Phenotype definitions and covariate strategy are specific enough to implement
Success criteria cover both validity and clinical usefulness

task_blueprints.title: Define cohort logic, endpoints, and phenotype rules
task_blueprints.description: Specify inclusion and exclusion logic, outcome definitions, and derivation rules for exposures and covariates.

task_blueprints.title: Draft the UKB extraction manifest and field map
task_blueprints.description: Create a field-level plan covering data returns, instances, coding tables, and derived variables.

quality_gate: Cohort extraction and derivation logic are reproducible
Pre-analysis statistics and cohort characterization are documented before formal modeling
The analysis plan includes missingness handling, confounding control, and validation strategy
Sensitivity analyses are sufficient to challenge the main claim

task_blueprints.title: Build the analysis-ready UKB cohort dataset
task_blueprints.description: Ingest approved UKB returns, produce a cohort manifest, perform QC, and save a cleaned analysis-ready table.

task_blueprints.title: Run UKB pre-analysis statistics and go/no-go assessment
task_blueprints.description: Using the analysis-ready UKB cohort table, screen the key exposure, core outcome, event-time structure, and essential covariates with a combined clinical and epidemiologic pre-analysis to judge prevalence or incidence support, crude and minimally adjusted effects, overlap, confounding signals, and whether the study should continue, pause, or be revised.

task_blueprints.title: Generate the UKB baseline table after pre-analysis sign-off
task_blueprints.description: Produce Table 1 and the cohort characterization only after the pre-analysis screen confirms that the design, exposure, outcome, and covariates are aligned or after the cohort plan has been revised.

task_blueprints.title: Run the primary statistical analysis and sensitivity checks
task_blueprints.description: Execute the main model, validate assumptions, and summarize robustness checks and clinically meaningful effect sizes.

quality_gate: Methods and cohort derivation are documented precisely enough for peer review
Figures and tables cover cohort flow, baseline characteristics, and primary/sensitivity results
Reproducibility artifacts are clearly scoped within UKB access constraints

task_blueprints.title: Draft cohort methods and results for publication
task_blueprints.description: Write the paper sections covering cohort derivation, statistical methods, and key findings with appropriate tables and figures.

task_blueprints.title: Prepare the reproducibility bundle and submission checklist
task_blueprints.description: Package the field manifest, analysis specification, and submission checklist while respecting UKB sharing constraints.

quality_gate: Presentation assets communicate cohort design, effect sizes, and practical significance clearly
Public-facing materials respect UKB data-use and sharing constraints

task_blueprints.title: Build the clinical storyline for slides and homepage
task_blueprints.description: Translate the study design and main findings into a concise, clinically meaningful narrative.

task_blueprints.title: Assemble figures, narration notes, and delivery assets
task_blueprints.description: Prepare a presentation-ready asset bundle with charts, talk notes, and any permitted public-facing visuals.
